evidenceProvenance.controller: OpenBlade.Capture uncommitted developer validator derived from product head 132fc01

action.name: Negative direct Fixed 2200 then presumed Auto handback validation
action.value: One acknowledged 0D/10 01022C apply followed by one acknowledged 0D/10 000600 cleanup

validation.applyResult: The exact Fixed 2200 candidate returned a status-02 semantic echo, but the only available 0D/81 getter remained 010500 and did not confirm an active mode or target change.
validation.readbackResult: Readback failed semantically: the getter was unchanged at raw 00. The validator therefore did not ask the operator to confirm physical Fixed behavior.
validation.restorationResult: The presumed Auto handback 000600 returned a status-02 semantic echo once; it was not retried.
validation.restorationReadbackResult: The 0D/81 getter remained 010500, but Synapse subsequently reported the device in sleep mode and the pad flashed red. USB-only reconnect did not recover it; disconnecting both USB and 12V power, waiting, then reconnecting 12V before USB restored the pad.

sanitizedEvidence.summary: The validator confirmed exact RZ09-0581 BIOS 4.00, one exact PID 0F43 usage 000C:0001 91-byte collection, inactive Synapse, and inactive OpenBlade service.
One Fixed candidate 01022C was acknowledged, but the 0D/81 getter remained 010500; this getter cannot validate active Fixed mode or configured target for this transition.
One 000600 cleanup was acknowledged and the getter remained 010500, but the pad entered a Synapse-reported sleep state with flashing red lighting and required a full USB-plus-12V power cycle.

limitations: The vendor oracle capture correlates 000600 with the operator selecting Auto in Synapse, but this direct standalone replay did not reproduce a safe Auto handback and must supersede that interpretation for OpenBlade.
A status-02 semantic echo proves command acceptance only. It did not prove the requested active mode or safe restoration.
The 0D/81 getter cannot be used as active-mode, configured-target-transition, or physical-speed readback for this validation.
The operator did not get a chance to confirm physical Fixed 2200 behavior because the false getter requirement failed immediately and cleanup ran.
The raw transcript and wrapper manifest remain private and uncommitted.

productionAdmission.reason: The only direct OpenBlade trial lacked semantic active-mode readback, and the presumed Auto cleanup left the pad asleep until a full hardware power cycle. No production fan writer or reversible validator is admitted.

notes: The unsafe validator was removed from the product worktree after this result and will not be committed.
OpenBlade and both Razer services were running and Synapse was relaunched after the bounded command session.
The operator confirmed recovery only after disconnecting both pad USB and 12V power, waiting, reconnecting 12V first, and then reconnecting USB.
